day2_morning_wakeup_1.text: *The alarm goes off. I open my eyes. Day 2.*

day2_morning_wakeup_2.text: *The transfer papers I had folded the day before lay neatly on the corner of my desk. My bag feels lighter than yesterday.*

day2_morning_wakeup_4.text: *The old school group chat... under "Read by 3," another gray timestamp had appeared. No reply.*

day2_morning_wakeup_6.text: *There is a message from Sea. 01:03. The "Good night" notification sits right above the low battery warning.*

day2_morning_wakeup_7.text: *I arrive at the school gate... and Sea is standing there.*

day2_morning_gate_1.text: Hey! I was waiting so we could walk together.

day2_morning_gate_2.text: ...You were waiting? What time did you get here?

day2_morning_gate_3.text: I just got here. I live close by. You picked up a lot of cherry petals on the way.

day2_morning_gate_4.text: *Damp dirt has dried onto the toes of Sea's sneakers. For someone who just arrived, the color is too dark.*

day2_morning_gate_5.text: *From the gate to the classroom. Sea walks beside me.*

day2_morning_walk_1.text: What did you do yesterday? At home.

day2_morning_walk_2.text: Made some instant noodles, scrolled on my phone, then went to sleep. Nothing much.

day2_morning_walk_3.text: ...Do you eat instant noodles every day when you live alone?

day2_morning_walk_4.text: No, sometimes I get convenience store meals too.

day2_morning_walk_6.text: *Sea starts to touch my forehead, then stops when she sees the empty water bottle in my hand.*

day2_morning_walk_7.text: I'll pack a little extra lunch tomorrow. If there's any left, let's eat together.

day2_morning_walk_8.text: ...Is it okay for you to look after me this much?

day2_morning_walk_9.text: I keep ending up with extra anyway. It'd be a waste to throw it out.

day2_morning_walk_10.text: *Sea walks ahead without looking back. Only the end of her sentence bounces brightly.*

day2_morning_walk_11.text: Oh right, {name}, what kind of music do you listen to?

day2_morning_walk_12.text: I'm not picky. I listen to whatever sounds good.

day2_morning_walk_13.text: me too. But you've fallen in love with this singer these days. The voice is a bit lonely.

day2_morning_walk_14.text: *Sea shows me her phone. An indie band channel.*

day2_morning_walk_15.text: Oh, I know this song. It popped up in my algorithm once.

day2_morning_walk_17.text: *Sea's thumb stops over the screen. The speed she was flipping through the playlist with a moment ago has slowed.*

day2_morning_deja4_1.text: *Walking to class with Sea, I feel thirsty.*

day2_morning_deja4_2.text: Hold on, where's the vending machine?

day2_morning_deja4_3.text: *Before I can say anything, my feet have already turned toward the second-floor stairs.*

day2_morning_deja4_4.text: Oh, right. There's a vending machine there. ...But {name}, how did you know that?

day2_morning_deja4_5.text: *The hallway sign is on the opposite wall. My eyes are pointed that way, but my hand is already taking out my wallet.*

day2_morning_deja4_6.text: Oh, I probably saw it when I passed by earlier.

day2_morning_class_2.text: *Sea smiles. She presses the corner of her phone hard once with her thumb, then slips it into her pocket.*

day2_morning_class_3.text: *Eunsu takes attendance. Names are called one by one.*

day2_morning_class_4.text: *...A page of the attendance book turns. Behind me, chair legs scrape briefly across the floor. Seolhwa is sitting there. But among the names just called, there was no name for that seat.*

day2_morning_class_5.text: *The speaker above the blackboard gives a short buzz, and Eunsu opens the next page. No one looks back.*

day2_morning_class_6.text: By the way, {name}, have you heard anything from your previous school?

day2_morning_pres_1.text: Transferring takes a while for the paperwork to go through. Let me know if they contact you.

day2_morning_pres_2.text: *First period, Korean Language. Eunsu teaches the class.*

day2_morning_pres_3.text: Today we have group presentations. The topic is 'My Favorite Place.'

day2_morning_pres_4.text: *Looking at the group assignments, I'm with Sea and a boy I don't really know.*

day2_morning_pres_5.text: We're in the same group! What should we do? We need to pick a topic.

day2_morning_pres_6.text: A cafe or something? Honestly, anything's fine, right?

day2_morning_pres_7.text: Hmm... how about the library? It's quiet.

day2_morning_pres_8.text: Nice. Should I make the slides?

day2_morning_pres_9.text: I'll present, and how about you look up the materials?

day2_morning_pres_11.text: *Sea gives me a thumbs-up. In Sea's notebook, the title `Library Presentation_{name}` is already written.*

day2_morning_pres_12.text: *It was our group’s turn to present. As soon as I stepped up front, the words kept coming without catching. Sea nodded before I had to search for the next sentence.*

day2_morning_deja5_1.text: {name}, great presentation. You must have presented a lot at your previous school.

day2_morning_deja5_3.text: *When I thought of my old classroom, the windows and desks were there, but my seat in front of the board was left blank white. Even so, my palms weren’t sweating.*

day2_morning_deja5_4.text: *Break time. Eunsu comes to my desk.*

day2_morning_deja5_5.text: Settling in okay? You’re walking faster than yesterday.

day2_morning_deja5_7.text: *The shoulder Eunsu’s hand had touched went cold for a moment. A metallic smell lingered, like the copier in the teachers’ office.*

day2_morning_deja5_10.text: Tell me right away if anything bothers you. I'm your homeroom teacher.

day2_morning_seolhwa_2.text: *Break time. I glance behind me. My eyes meet the girl by the window.*

day2_morning_seolhwa_3.text: *...This time, she doesn't look away. She's watching me. Quietly.*

day2_morning_seolhwa_4.text: *The girl’s lips moved, just barely. Right before the first syllable came out, the sound of a chair scraping from the hallway overlapped it.*

day2_morning_seolhwa_5.text: *The kid beside me chattered and glanced back, but their gaze slipped a little to the right of Seolhwa. When the teacher said "Focus!" I looked forward again.*
